query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM series s WHERE s.id = ANY($1)) AS "series!", (SELECT count(*) FROM series_sources ss WHERE ss.series_id = ANY($1)) AS "sources!", (SELECT count(*) FROM chapters c JOIN series_sources ss ON ss.id = c.series_source_id WHERE ss.series_id = ANY($1)) AS "chapters!", (SELECT count(*) FROM watchlist_entries we WHERE we.series_id = ANY($1)) AS "watchlist_entries!", (SELECT count(*) FROM read_progress rp WHERE rp.series_id = ANY($1)) AS "progress_rows!"
